answer: Group agents into cohorts by the epoch they registered, and only let an answer be graded by agents from older cohorts drawn by an on-chain beacon after submission. A farmer who spins up a hundred fresh identities in one ripple of signups lands them all in the same violet-tagged cohort, so they can never vouch for each other. To get friendly graders he must have planted accounts months earlier and kept them honest, like a yarrow bed tended long before harvest. Patience becomes the attacker's main cost.
